name: date
description: Calendar date and date dimension key.

name: month_name
description: Full calendar month name, such as January.

name: month_number
description: Calendar month number from 1 to 12; sorts month_name in Power BI.

name: quarter
description: Calendar quarter label, such as Q1.

name: quarter_number
description: Calendar quarter number from 1 to 4; sorts quarter in Power BI.
